Rider-Waite-Smith tarot card images (vendor/tarot/*.jpg)

Artwork: Pamela Colman Smith, under the direction of Arthur Edward Waite.
Published by William Rider & Son, London, 1909 ("Roses & Lilies" first-edition scans).
License: PUBLIC DOMAIN (author died 1951; published 1909, public domain in the US and in countries with life+70 or shorter terms).
Source: Wikimedia Commons, Category:Rider-Waite tarot deck (Roses & Lilies)
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Rider-Waite_tarot_deck_(Roses_%26_Lilies)
Processing: Commons 330px thumbnails, resized to 260px wide, light denoise, re-encoded as progressive JPEG (<=35 KB each) for offline use.
